Uncertainty.description: On probability, randomness, and the strange comfort of realizing you were never really in control to begin with.

Love, Loss & Family.description: Stories from a marriage, a childhood, and the family in between — love and grief as they actually happen, not as they're supposed to.

Financial Awareness.description: Money as it's actually lived: budgets, mortgages, market psychology, and the small financial choices that quietly add up to a life.

Authenticity & Vulnerability.description: On identity, faith, mortality, and the immigrant journey — the harder conversations about who we are when no one's watching.

Self-Awareness & EQ.description: Commutes, coffee, and other small daily moments that, looked at closely enough, turn into essays on attention, patience, and presence.

Old Voice.description: Earlier essays, written in an earlier voice — kept here because they still hold up, even if I'd say it differently today.
